title: The Firmament - Vaulted Dome of the Earth
author: Zen Garcia
description: Zen Garcia presents a reading of the firmament and biblical cosmology centred on a vaulted earth. The work records the author's scriptural interpretation and cosmological claims, which should be distinguished from modern astronomical models.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
